verdict.rationale: Proa is a web framework with a dev server, so an official end-to-end testing integration is a fair axis. The evidence pack documents no such tool. The closest items are the dev server, build-time WCAG/ARIA checks, `--deny warnings` lints and `proa fmt --check`, which are adjacent static checks rather than end-to-end testing.

support.subject: As a developer, I can integrate official end-to-end testing tools that work out of the box with the framework's dev server
